thresholds._comment: Per-ROI anomaly thresholds. Generated by scripts/calibrate_roi_thresholds.py
thresholds._comment2: Values are float 0.0-1.0. Score above threshold = FAIL for that ROI.
thresholds._comment3: 3 ROI folders: ROI_LOGO, ROI_INGREDIENT, ROI_BARCODE (all grayscale crops).
thresholds._comment4: Full NSC images are RGB. Crops were saved as grayscale before training.
thresholds._comment5: Default 0.5 = placeholder. Run calibrate_roi_thresholds.py before inference.

details._comment: Per-ROI calibration details populated by calibrate_roi_thresholds.py
